architecture:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production transparent architecture sprite atlas for a lively watercolor city game, 5 columns by 4 rows, exactly 20 independent sprite cells on a transparent background. Canvas 1536 by 1024 or larger same 3:2 ratio. Each cell occupies exactly one fifth of width and one quarter of height. Plenty of transparent padding between objects, no overlap across cell boundaries. Every object fits wholly inside its cell. All objects grounded at the bottom of their own cell. No labels, no borders, no letters, no sky, no mountains, no distant horizon, no backdrop, no cast shadows outside the sprite.
Style: rich detailed pen-and-watercolor architectural cutouts, crisp ink, saturated cheerful pigments, exquisite masonry and botanical detail, elevated three-quarter view with front facade dominant. Consistent lighting from upper left, bright daytime, natural uncompressed proportions. These are separate modules to be assembled into a dynamically animated city, not a scene painting. NO PEOPLE OR VEHICLES baked into architecture; these will be separate live animated sprites.

actors:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE transparent production animation sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, canvas 1536x1024. Each cell 384x256. Bright detailed pen-and-watercolor, saturated pigments, matching an architectural watercolor city diorama. No background, shadows, text or extra objects. Each row is a four-frame action cycle of the SAME character/vehicle, drawn at IDENTICAL SCALE, facing right, feet or wheels at consistent local y=235, center x=192, leave ample padding. Respect rows/columns rigorously.
Row 1: cheerful gardener in green apron and straw hat, long rake and vivid pink flower planter. Four ACTUALLY DIFFERENT poses sweeping the rake, bending down, lifting rake, resetting. Person readable, warm skin and orange shirt. Full body, no scenery.
Row 2: construction worker in yellow hardhat and bright coral safety vest, hammer and a small stack of bricks. Four ACTUALLY DIFFERENT hammer action poses: arm up, striking down, bending to collect brick, arm rising. No structure.
Row 3: casual cyclist in turquoise jacket on cobalt bicycle with small front basket. Four ACTUALLY DIFFERENT pedal poses around a full revolution. Side profile facing right, same wheels and proportions, body stays registered.
Row 4: elegant compact urban passenger tram in turquoise navy and warm gold, visible passengers through broad windows, side profile facing right. Four frames showing wheel rotations and subtle passenger variations. Full vehicle including front/rear, not cropped, same exact vehicle body registration in all four frames.
Each row is animation not four different characters. All sprites entirely inside cells. Full alpha transparency. Detailed watercolor, fine dark ink, rich clean color, no faded beige or fog.
crane:

Asset type: standalone transparent production construction crane sprite for watercolor dioramas.
Primary request: produce a bright yellow tower crane matching the attached reference, full mast grounded on base, upper lattice boom extending right. Detailed fine dark ink and saturated watercolor, preserve construction realism and natural proportions. Leave the right side below the boom fully transparent. Transparent background, no people, no backdrop, no text. Whole crane visible and unclipped, mast high, clear boom silhouette, strong yellow safety paint.
